files.notes: Adds false-by-default per-group selfie requirement; existing groups preserve previous optional behavior. Additive schema alone does not establish upload validation or biometric-data handling policy.

Adds organizing company name via temporary empty default then removes default, nullable opt-in timestamp, unique normalized support contacts with ordered indexes and rendered/template message metadata. Current consent enforcement, message redaction and retention require runtime evidence; no provider call executed.
Adds optional message batch UUID/index without fabricating existing batch associations; no FK is introduced here. Shared WhatsApp batching remains in scope independent of deferred Operations Inbox.

Adds status_updated_at nullable, backfills created_at for every missing timestamp then makes it required. Keeps old log chronology instead of stamping migration time; populated Postgres execution/locks not qualified.

Adds camera/file acquisition checks, group-scoped nullable upload idempotency uniqueness, nonnegative extraction revisions and explicit historical status backfill. Before active-revision unique index, deterministically ranks and cancels older queued/running jobs, preserving newest created_at/id row; current queue concurrency/cancellation not proven from schema alone.

Adds non-null empty-list JSONB extraction conflicts without overwriting passport fields; downgrade removes only metadata. Current conflict merge/redaction/schema validation remain runtime obligations.

Adds canonical status enum labels, optional verification/reviewer metadata with reviewer SETNULL, nonnegative revisions and durable bounded-attempt revision-unique verification jobs. Downgrade maps canonical statuses to legacy labels with bindparams while deliberately retaining PG enum labels; no new labels are assigned to existing rows in upgrade. DB enum/transaction/runtime worker qualification not performed.

Adds recipient soft-removal and durable unique recipient/message-type state. Backfill expires old queued as failed, marks interrupted processing delivery_unknown and favors accepted/ambiguous outcomes over retryable failures using DISTINCT ON. Ambiguous external outcomes stay suppressed; automatic resend safety is not inferred. Downgrade narrows message_type64 to32 without truncation, a conditional historical populated rollback compatibility point, not a current supported-release failure.

Qualifier choice, allowed relation codes, expiry ordering, unique hashed token, same-group composite FK and single-use selection uniqueness fully read. Snapshot check enforces disabled-null versus enabled complete Self/relation shape; upgrade leaves existing groups disabled. RESTRICT association deletion is intentional historical relational behavior; current purge and capability expiry enforcement require runtime evidence.

Adds stored template/header parameter snapshots plus false-by-default explicit resend. Partial unique recipient/message index includes queued/processing/delivery_unknown, preserving unknown-outcome duplicate suppression; no live send/idempotency behavior established from schema alone.

Creates unique client-group/broadcast link with agency/entity cascades, creator SETNULL and scoped indexes. Early individual FKs alone do not guarantee all linked owners match; later composite invariants/current authorization remain separate.

Adds non-null empty-object recipient imported_fields JSONB; database has no JSON byte/shape bound in this declaration. Importer runtime limits must be traced separately; no input campaign or provider activity performed.

Updates persisted global platform name only when exact previous PassDetection default matches, preserving other custom values and JSON keys. Downgrade reverses only the exact new default; no deployment identifier/config changes.

Creates separate non-sendable rejected contacts with row-number/reason-code checks, group+fingerprint uniqueness, agency/group cascades and indexed history. Raw name/phone/file metadata are sensitive retained data; current access/retention proof must come from later schema/runtime, not source declarations.
Adds empty-object imported fields to rejected contacts, preserving spreadsheet metadata without changing sendable recipient rows. Runtime data bounds and retention are independent obligations.

Creates non-destructive crop metadata: source/derived references, bounded fractional crop, minimum dimensions, right-angle rotation, positive source sizes/revision and one submission/image type. Submission cascade/editor SETNULL preserved; relational deletion does not prove derived object deletion, and current authority remains runtime scope.

notes: Complete0029–0044 physical reads in three bounded outputs. Operations Inbox deferred; retained WhatsApp/domain metadata is distinct. No runtime/migration changes or service proof.
